mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tech_stack, frequent_topics, answer_style, project_context, raw_summary, conversation_count, updated_at, created_at FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, tech_stack, frequent_topics, answer_style, project_context, raw_summary, conversation_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{techStack}, #{frequentTopics}, #{answerStyle}, #{projectContext}, #{rawSummary}, #{conversationCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET tech_stack = #{techStack}, frequent_topics = #{frequentTopics}, answer_style = #{answerStyle}, project_context = #{projectContext}, raw_summary = #{rawSummary} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
